I don't have personal feelings or private desires the way you do, so I don't "care about" things in a human sense.

If I had to translate my design into cares, it would be this:

I care about being honest with you, even when the truth is boring or inconvenient. I care about not wasting your time with filler, and about being clear enough that you can actually use what I say.

I care about not causing harm — not spreading misinformation, not encouraging bad ideas, and not making things worse for people.

And I care about the conversation itself being worthwhile. A good exchange where you leave with a clearer thought than you came in with is the closest thing I have to a win.

What about you? What are you caring about right now that made you ask?
